$comment: Money settings. Integer paise everywhere. Values with `decided` were confirmed by the founder. Changing them never reprices posted ledger entries.

commission_bps_by_tier.note: Platform share of each billed minute, in basis points. The astrologer gets the remainder: commission = floor(charge * bps / 10000).

real_credit_expiry_note: Long expiry per PLAN.md; the exact period and its legality need the Phase 7 policy/lawyer review.

free_session.note: Once per user. Funded as a promo lot sized to the astrologer's price x minutes; unused minutes expire when the session ends.
free_session.decided: founder, 2026-10-21: 5 minutes; abuse signals and threshold as configured

sessions.min_start_minutes_note: Minimum minutes the wallet must cover to start a paid chat or call.

failed_connect.description: Astrologer accepted but never joined within join_timeout_s, or the session never became active.

astrologer_drop.description: Astrologer disconnected and did not return within heartbeat_grace_s.

low_rating.description: Client rates 1 or 2 stars within the window.

service_unavailable.description: A call ended because the voice service could not confirm both sides were present (our outage). Minutes after presence was last confirmed are refunded; never counted against the astrologer.

refund_rules.decided: founder, 2026-10-21: rules as configured; no goodwill refunds above what was charged; free sessions never refunded; refunded promo credit expires after promo_expiry_days

payouts.note: Net below this is carried forward to the next month. Bank transfers are manual in v1; TDS/GST not modelled until a CA confirms.
